scope: Complete local CPU Notebook computation: original ten-bit subset-majority data and shuffle, disjoint 340/512 split, batch size 64, Linear/Tanh/quantum/Linear/ReLU network, pinned pretrained weights, SGD(lr=0.05), MSE, one-epoch continuation and 30-epoch from-scratch training, rounded-label held-out evaluation. Exact complex128 readout replaces the original 4096-shot QLayer; no sampled, hardware, convergence or scalability claim.
native_semantic_adaptations: Preserve all four encoded features, three quantum angles, source logical register order, architecture, loss and optimizer. Compose the existing fq.Module with a differentiable Circuit builder; entrywise complete-state tests link it to the native qfunc program. Float64 classical parameters and exact complex128 expectations replace float32/4096-shot execution. Store the five original checkpoint tensors as JSON, map qlayer.weight to qlayer.parameters_tensor, and preserve every float32 value exactly as a float64 value. The final RZZ angle has zero gradient for Z-only marginals because the operators commute; it remains present. Seed local shuffling and initialization for reproducibility; training metrics need not improve monotonically.

pretrained_checkpoint.conversion: torch.load(weights_only=True, map_location="cpu"); tensor.tolist(); no weight fitting or rounding
